matches.preview: Derby are slight favourites at 47%, though Swansea's 26% winning chances combined with the 27% draw probability make this a finely balanced contest. Last season saw Derby record decidedly mixed results with three wins and three losses, whilst Swansea demonstrated noticeably stronger form with three wins in their closing games. Derby hold a clear advantage in recent head-to-head meetings, winning both of their last two encounters, including a 2-0 victory. The model leans slightly towards under 2.5 goals at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Derby為輕微熱門球隊，勝率為47%，Swansea的勝率為26%，平局概率為27%，使得這場比賽勢均力敵。上賽季Derby戰績混合，三勝三負，而Swansea表現明顯較強，最後三場全勝。在近期交手中，Derby佔明顯優勢，最近兩次交手均告獲勝，其中包括2-0的勝利。模型輕微傾向於2.5球以下，概率為54%。

matches.preview: The model gives Middlesbrough a modest 52% edge at home, with the 26% draw probability marking this as finely balanced. Middlesbrough have won all five recent head-to-head meetings with West Brom. Their end-of-season form was notably mixed: a 5-1 home victory was offset by multiple draws and a defeat at home. West Brom showed defensive solidity with several 0-0 results in that same period, though they lack the attacking threat evident in those recent meetings. Total goals remain evenly balanced.
matches.preview_zh: 模型給予Middlesbrough主場52%的微弱優勢，26%的平手機率表示本場比賽勢均力敵。Middlesbrough在最近五次與West Brom的交手紀錄中全數勝出。他們的賽季末表現相當參差不齊：一場5:1的主場勝利被多場平手及一次主場敗績所抵銷。West Brom在同期展現出防線堅實，有多場0:0的比賽，但缺乏在最近交手中所展現的進攻威脅。總進球數保持平衡。

matches.preview: The model favours Wolverhampton at 59%, giving Stoke just 17% chance of victory, while draws are forecast at 24%. Wolverhampton's final matches of last season showed clear inconsistency, alternating between draws and losses without any sustained momentum heading into this fixture. Stoke's closing campaign proved considerably more troubling, with five defeats among their last six games, a pattern that illustrates the genuine challenges they face returning to Championship level. The forecast leans marginally toward goals, with over 2.5 at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型看好Wolverhampton，勝率59%，Stoke則僅有17%的勝率機會，平局預測為24%。Wolverhampton上季末期的賽事表現明顯不穩定，在平局與敗績之間交替，進入本場比賽前缺乏持續的勢頭。Stoke的收官階段戰績相當令人擔憂，最後六場比賽中有五場敗績，這種模式反映出他們重返Championship級別所面臨的真實困難。預測略微傾向較多進球，超過2.5球的預測為54%。

matches.preview: Blackburn Rovers hold a marginal 45% model edge, though the draw and Queens Park Rangers victory are closely matched at 28% each, suggesting an evenly poised encounter. Last season's form lines show Blackburn finishing with mixed results, whilst Queens Park Rangers endured a difficult spell with just two draws and four defeats from their final six games. Their most recent direct meeting delivered a commanding 3-1 Blackburn victory. The model favours a lower-scoring contest at 54% for under 2.5 goals.
matches.preview_zh: Blackburn Rovers在模型預測中佔微弱的45%優勢，平局及Queens Park Rangers勝利則各佔28%，表明這場對陣勢均力敵。上賽季戰績顯示Blackburn表現參差不齊，而Queens Park Rangers在最後六場比賽中僅有兩場平局和四場敗績。雙方最近一次交手中，Blackburn以3：1大勝。該模型傾向於預測進球數少於2.5球的比賽，概率達54%。

matches.preview: Bristol City's model edge of 45% reflects a modest home advantage, though this is no clear-cut situation with Portsmouth also at 27%. Last season brought mixed results for the home side, whilst Portsmouth enjoyed a strong finish with five wins in their final six matches. In recent head-to-head meetings, Bristol City have won three of the last four, including a 5-0 victory. The model leans under 2.5 goals at 54%, suggesting this may yet prove a cautious and tightly contested affair.
matches.preview_zh: Bristol City 的模型優勢為 45%，反映其主場優勢有限；Portsmouth 的可能性也高達 27%，這並非一場勝負已定的比賽。上賽季 Bristol City 的表現參差不齊，而 Portsmouth 則展現強勢收尾，最後六場比賽贏得五場。在最近的相互對戰中，Bristol City 在最後四場中贏得三場，其中包括一場 5-0 的勝利。模型傾向於小於 2.5 球的情況，佔比 54%，這暗示該場比賽可能會是一場謹慎而激烈的對陣。

matches.preview: The model gives Norwich a slight edge at 39%, but this is finely balanced with Burnley at 34% and a 28% draw probability. Both clubs return from the previous season: Norwich regrouping in the Championship, Burnley stepping down from the Premier League. In their head-to-head record, Burnley has won the last four meetings between them. The forecast leans marginally toward over 2.5 goals at 52%, indicating goals are likely but far from certain.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測Norwich略占優勢，獲勝機率為39%，但與Burnley的34%相差不遠，平手的機率為28%。兩隊都從上一個賽季回歸：Norwich在Championship重新集結，Burnley從Premier League降級。在直接對陣紀錄中，Burnley贏得了他們之間最近的四場比賽。預測稍微傾向超過2.5球，機率為52%，表明進球可能發生，但遠非確定。

matches.preview: Sheffield United edges this match at 39% against Cardiff City's 34%, with the 28% draw likelihood suggesting a finely balanced contest. Cardiff return to the Championship after time outside the top two divisions, their recent history showing mixed outcomes. Sheffield United's form across the last four months is split exactly: three wins and three losses, illustrating inconsistency despite occasional strong performances. The head-to-head record decisively favours the visitors, with Sheffield United unbeaten in their five recent meetings with Cardiff, including a 2-0 victory in their last encounter. The model leans towards goals, favouring over 2.5 at 54%.
matches.preview_zh: Sheffield United 在這場比賽中領先 39% 對陣 Cardiff City 的 34%，28% 的平局機率顯示這是一場勢均力敵的較量。Cardiff 在久未參加頂級兩個聯賽後重返英冠，其近期戰績顯示成績參差不齊。Sheffield United 在過去四個月的戰績分為上下兩半：三勝三敗，儘管偶爾有出色表現，但這反映出其成績的不穩定性。直接對陣紀錄明顯有利於客隊，Sheffield United 在近期與 Cardiff 的五場交手中保持不敗，包括上次交手 2-0 獲勝。該模型傾向於進球較多，看好進球總數超過 2.5 個的情況達到 54%。

matches.preview: The model slightly favours Charlton Athletic with a 39% win probability, though Preston remain quite competitive at 32% and the match is finely balanced with a 29% draw probability. Preston have won both their last two meetings, securing successive victories of 2-0 at home and 2-1 away in April. Both clubs are returning to this level after mixed form at the close of last season. The model expects a low-scoring encounter, with under 2.5 goals strongly favoured at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型略微傾向Charlton Athletic，獲勝概率為39%，不過Preston仍保持相當競爭力，勝率為32%，比賽總體非常均衡，平局概率為29%。Preston在最近兩次交手中都取得勝利，分別在4月主場以2-0及客場以2-1連勝。兩支球隊都在上賽季末表現起伏不定後重返這個級別。模型預計這場比賽進球較少，少於2.5球的概率為57%。

matches.preview: Southampton are slight favourites at 46% to claim victory, though the model suggests a tight contest with Millwall on 28% and a draw at 27%. Last season Southampton concluded with four wins and two draws, while Millwall recorded three wins, two draws and one loss. Recent encounters between the sides are split, with a high-scoring 3-2 Millwall victory and a goalless draw among their past meetings. The model leans marginally towards over 2.5 goals at 52%, pointing to a relatively open match.
matches.preview_zh: Southampton 以46%微幅領先，儘管模型顯示與Millwall（28%）的對陣將會緊湊，平局的機率為27%。上個賽季Southampton 以四場勝利和兩場平局作收，而Millwall 錄得三場勝利、兩場平局和一場敗績。雙方近期交手相當，既有Millwall 3:2的高比分勝利，也有0:0平局。模型略傾向於進球數超過2.5場（52%），反映出這將是一場相對開放的比賽。

matches.preview: West Ham United are the model's clear preference at 57%, though not overwhelmingly so. Watford are returning to Championship level after a disastrous end to last season, taking just one point from their final six games, which included heavy defeats to Coventry, Middlesbrough and West Brom. West Ham's form last season was decidedly mixed, but they hold a commanding record against Watford, winning all five recent encounters between the sides. The model leans toward goals, favoring over 2.5 at 57%.
matches.preview_zh: West Ham United是模型的明確偏好（57%），但並非壓倒性優勢。Watford重返英冠級別，上季末期表現災難性，最後六場比賽僅取得一分，其中包括對Coventry、Middlesbrough和West Brom的慘敗。West Ham上季狀態明顯不穩定，但對陣Watford保有優異的交手戰績，最近五次對賽全勝。模型傾向於進球較多，預測2.5球以上達57%。
